name: Ring of Water Walking

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: You can walk on liquid as if it were solid ground.
text: Any liquid surface supports you like solid ground while you wear this ring, letting you stand on it and move across it.
